text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Org 'lynkware' experiencing sustained 6x request rate increase to /v1/generate (latency p95 > 2.5s, errors rising). Pager: oncall-alex.
oncall-alex: got it. Paging SRE + ENG. I'm taking initial triage. Any ongoing customer mitigation history for Lynkware? @cs-ana
cs-ana: Lynkware on Dedicated with soft quotas. They've got an important batch job running every 5m today per their support ticket. They warned they might spike during import. No prior emergency overrides.
sre-maya: metrics: see grafana/r/lynkware-inbound (embedding link). p95 and 5xx started climbing at 5090002100. Backend nodes are saturating, queue depth up. Likely burst + big prompt sizes.
eng-luke: looks like kernel queueing on their model variant. We should preserve availability for other orgs. Proposal: apply targeted org-level qps cap and enable traffic shaping fallback -> route to a lightweight decode model for heavy prompts.
oncall-alex: agree. Quick steps: 1) temp soft quota downshift to 25 qps for org. 2) enable model fallback for requests > 2k tokens. 3) notify customer support and put incident page.
oncall-alex: executing step 1 now:
```
redwoodctl org update-rate --org lynkware --qps 25 --scope org --ttl 1800 --reason "emergency mitigation - spike"
```
incident-bot: change applied by oncall-alex at 5090002260. New org cap: 25 qps (TTL 1800s).
cs-ana: I just DM'd the customer and opened ticket INC-6678 to inform them of temporary cap + ask them to pause import.
eng-luke: enabling fallback rules (will knob off non-essential transforms). Command:
```
redwoodctl routing set-fallback --org lynkware --condition "tokens>2000" --target model:light-1 --ttl 1800
```
sre-maya: after cap and fallback, queue depth dropped ~40% in the next 30s, p95 trending down. No cross-org regressions observed on dashboards.
oncall-alex: good. We should also disable a noisy feature for this org (batch-aggregation) to reduce amplification.
eng-luke: disabled batch-aggregation flag for lynkware via featureflags/ui -> flag set at 5090002320.
pm-jordan: (PM) Please capture decision for postmortem — need root cause and customer impact, and potential permanent quota knob.
cs-ana: customer confirmed they can pause their import. They've asked for timeline. I said we'll reassess in ~20m and aim to restore.
incident-bot: oncall handoff reminder: oncall-alex -> sre-maya at 5090002400 for watch and rollback planning.
sre-maya: taking watch. I'll leave fallback + cap in place, monitor for 30m, and coordinate rollback if stable. If errors <0.5% and p95 <1.2s for 10m, we incrementally raise qps to 50.
sre-maya: adding runbook note: runbook/mitigate-org-spike.md step 4 applied. Recording commands used in incident log.
oncall-alex: thanks team — continuing to finalise notes, will file post-action items. :+1:
pm-jordan: adding customer follow-up item and request for quota policy review in weekly infra sync.
cs-ana: I'll follow up with Lynkware on status in 15m and share their response in the thread.
sre-maya: at 5090002455 metrics look stable enough for a controlled bump. I'll coordinate ramp once CS confirms import paused.
